en: Awakening of insects thunder wakes all things.
ja: 驚蟄の雷がすべての生き物を目覚めさせます。
local: Awakening of insects thunder wakes all things.
ja_pron: Keichitsu no kaminari ga subete no ikimono o mezamesasemasu
native: Awakening of insects thunder wakes all things.

en: Around March 6, the first spring thunder booms across the sky.
zh: 約在三月六日，第一聲春雷響徹天空。
ja: 3月6日頃、最初の春雷が空に轟きます。
local: Around March 6, the first spring thunder booms across the sky.
ja_pron: San-gatsu muika goro, saisho no shunrai ga sora ni todorokimasu
native: Around March 6, the first spring thunder booms across the sky.

en: This is Jingsha, the Awakening of insects.
zh: 這是驚蟄節氣，驚蟄的意思是昆蟲甦醒。
ja: これは驚蟄（けいちつ）で、昆虫が目覚める時期です。
local: This is Jingsha, the Awakening of insects.
ja_pron: Kore wa Keichitsu de, konchū ga mezameru jiki desu
native: This is Jingsha, the Awakening of insects.

en: All winter, insects, frogs, and snakes have been sleeping underground.
zh: 整個冬天，昆蟲、青蛙和蛇都在地下冬眠。
ja: 冬の間、昆虫やカエル、ヘビは地下で冬眠しています。
local: All winter, insects, frogs, and snakes have been sleeping underground.
ja_pron: Fuyu no aida, konchū ya kaeru, hebi wa chika de tōmin shiteimasu
native: All winter, insects, frogs, and snakes have been sleeping underground.

en: The thunder is like a big alarm clock.
ja: 雷は大きな目覚まし時計のようです。
local: The thunder is like a big alarm clock.
ja_pron: Kaminari wa ōkina mezamashi dokei no yō desu
native: The thunder is like a big alarm clock.

en: Boom, wake up, spring is here.
ja: ドーン、起きて、春が来ました。
local: Boom, wake up, spring is here.
native: Boom, wake up, spring is here.

en: The insects crawl out, the frogs start croaking.
zh: 昆蟲爬出來，青蛙開始呱呱叫。
ja: 昆虫が這い出し、カエルが鳴き始めます。
local: The insects crawl out, the frogs start croaking.
ja_pron: Konchū ga haidashi, kaeru ga naki hajimemasu
native: The insects crawl out, the frogs start croaking.

en: Peach blossoms start to bloom pink and pretty.
zh: 桃花開始綻放，粉紅而美麗。
ja: 桃の花がピンク色に美しく咲き始めます。
local: Peach blossoms start to bloom pink and pretty.
ja_pron: Momo no hana ga pinku iro ni utsukushiku saki hajimemasu
native: Peach blossoms start to bloom pink and pretty.

en: Nature's alarm clock rings, and the whole world wakes up.
zh: 大自然的鬧鐘響起，整個世界甦醒。
ja: 自然の目覚まし時計が鳴り、世界中が目を覚まします。
local: Nature's alarm clock rings, and the whole world wakes up.
ja_pron: Shizen no mezamashi dokei ga nari, sekaijū ga me o samashimasu
native: Nature's alarm clock rings, and the whole world wakes up.
